description: Build the yearly work calendar of a workplace in Spain (ET art. 34.6) and square it with the annual hours of the collective agreement, which is what people get wrong: working days and hours with that schedule, the national and regional public holidays from the BOE, the two local ones, summer hours, closures and vacation, the effective hours, and how far they are from the agreement — days to give back or minutes to add per day. Warns about weeks over 40 hours, days over 9 hours, closures beyond vacation and local holidays that are not two.

annualHours.description: Maximum annual hours of the collective agreement

closures.description: Days the workplace closes: they count as everyone's vacation

localHolidays.description: The two local holidays of the municipality (ET art. 37.2): there is no single official source for them

region.description: Autonomous community, ISO 3166-2: ES-MD, ES-CT, ES-AN, ES-PV… (its regional holidays apply). Without it, national holidays only

summerHours.description: Intensive (summer) schedule between two days of the year, MM-DD

weeklyHours.description: Hours worked each weekday, Monday first: [8,8,8,8,8,0,0]

vacation.description: Annual vacation: the legal minimum is 30 calendar days (ET art. 38)

weeklyHours.description: Hours worked each weekday, Monday first: [8,8,8,8,8,0,0]

name: work_calendar
title: Spanish work calendar of a workplace, against the annual hours of the collective agreement
